chars.KHADIJA: KHADIJA: a young Moroccan woman, 28, wearing a mustard-yellow hijab, a long olive-green dress and round gold-rimmed glasses
chars.MOUAD: MOUAD: a Moroccan man in his early 30s with a short black beard, wearing a black leather bomber jacket over a white t-shirt, dark jeans and a silver wristwatch

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan apartment living room with a red sofa, MOUAD jerks his smartphone away and hides it behind his back with a guilty, defensive face while KHADIJA, sitting next to him, reaches toward it and glares at him with suspicious narrowed eyes. Comic tension, both faces clearly visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, MOUAD lies on the sofa smiling at his glowing phone screen (screen seen from behind, no readable text), while KHADIJA leans in from behind the sofa, sneakily peeking over his shoulder with wide curious eyes.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: On a small Moroccan apartment balcony at dusk, MOUAD whispers into his phone with a sly grin, turning away; in the foreground behind the balcony door KHADIJA watches him with crossed arms and one raised eyebrow, jealous and suspicious.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Late at night in a dim bedroom, MOUAD sleeps snoring with his mouth open; KHADIJA sits on the edge of the bed holding his phone in one hand and secretly copying numbers into a small notebook with a pen, glancing at him nervously. Blank notebook pages, no writing visible.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan kitchen, KHADIJA holds a second old phone to her ear and a notebook in the other hand, her face frozen in surprise, mouth open, as if a man's deep voice answered. Comic expression.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: MOUAD at the apartment door putting on his jacket, happily distracted, while in the foreground KHADIJA holds his phone close to her face with a clever triumphant smile, her thumb on the screen as if she just guessed the lock code. Screen shows no text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Evening at a busy Moroccan street café in Rabat with mint tea glasses on a small round table; MOUAD stands up from the table pointing toward the restroom, leaving his phone lying on the table, while KHADIJA, still seated, stares at the phone with tempted eyes.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At the café table with mint tea glasses, KHADIJA quickly grabs the phone from the table, hunched over it, looking left and right nervously like a spy, other café customers blurred in the background.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close-up at the café table: KHADIJA stares at the glowing phone in her hand with eyes popping wide and a hand over her mouth in total shock, her glasses sliding down her nose. Comic shocked reaction. The screen faces away from the viewer.
